newsitem.title: USA: Continucare to buy rheumatology practice.
newsitem.headline: Continucare to buy rheumatology practice.

text.p: Continucare Corp said on Thursday it signed a letter of intent to acquire Norman Gaylis M.D. Inc, a rheumatology practice subsidiary of Sheridan Healthcorp Inc for $1.9 million in cash.
The acquisition is expected to close by March 31, pending further due diligence and signing of a definitive agreement.
The company said this venture marks its first physician practice acquisition and the launch of Continucare's own rheumatology practice.
The company said it will continue to evaluate other specialty practices for acquisition, and expects to announce additional agreements in the next 90 days.
The company also said that the new practice specialty further enhances its recently announced plans to offer rehabilitation services at Bally Total Fitness centers nationwide.
Continucare manages operational, clinical and administrative programs for behavioral and physical rehabilitation service providers. Currently, it manages 32 outpatient centers in five states.
